name: Council
description: Three distinct models vote on a high-stakes question; a judge tallies, one deliberation round if split

frame.title: Frame

branches.prompt:
Project directory: {{inputs.dir}}
Brief:
{{results.frame.brief}}
Round 1: vote independently. You are read-only. Check the brief's items against the real code and tests; run commands if it helps. Do not change anything.
Lens: correctness and safety. Only you may veto, and only for a concrete safety or data-loss issue you can point to.
Reply with a ballot exactly in this shape:
verdict: approve|block|abstain
confidence: low|medium|high
veto: yes|no (skeptic only, otherwise no)
reasons:
- file:line evidence
conditions: what would change your vote
